spec.description: Network diagnostics for Domibus performance testing. Covers host and Domibus-container throughput, packet rate, errors, drops, TCP retransmissions/resets and directional traffic. Set the time range to one Run when analyzing experiment evidence.

spec.title: Host RX Throughput
spec.description: Current receive throughput on the selected host interface(s).

spec.title: Host TX Throughput
spec.description: Current transmit throughput on the selected host interface(s).

spec.title: Host Errors / Drops
spec.description: Combined host network error/drop rate. Healthy Runs should normally remain at zero.

spec.title: Domibus RX
spec.description: Current receive throughput for the Domibus containers.

spec.title: Domibus TX
spec.description: Current transmit throughput for the Domibus containers.

spec.title: TCP Retransmits
spec.description: TCP retransmitted segments per second, where the node_exporter netstat collector exposes the metric.

spec.title: Host Network Throughput
spec.description: Aggregate host RX/TX throughput for the selected interface(s).

spec.title: Host Packet Rate
spec.description: Host packet rate on the selected interface(s).

spec.title: Host Network Errors
spec.description: Host receive/transmit errors. Non-zero values during a Run should be investigated.

spec.title: Host Packet Drops
spec.description: Host receive/transmit packet drops.

spec.title: TCP Segment Rate
spec.description: TCP segment rate from node_exporter netstat metrics, where available.

spec.title: TCP Retransmissions
spec.description: TCP retransmitted segments per second. Useful for identifying transport-level loss or congestion.

spec.title: TCP Established Connections
spec.description: Currently established TCP connections, where exposed by node_exporter.

spec.title: TCP Resets
spec.description: TCP connection reset rates, where exposed by node_exporter.

spec.title: Domibus Container Network Throughput
spec.description: Container-level RX/TX throughput for Domibus only.

spec.title: Domibus Container Packet Rate
spec.description: Container-level packet rates for the Domibus containers.

spec.title: Domibus Container Network Errors
spec.description: Container-level network errors for Domibus.

spec.title: Domibus Container Packet Drops
spec.description: Container-level network packet drops for Domibus.

spec.title: AP Directional Traffic
spec.description: Use this panel to compare sender/receiver traffic patterns for A12 and A21 Runs.

spec.title: Cumulative Host Network Bytes
spec.description: Bytes received/transmitted over the current dashboard time range. Set the range to one Run for evidence comparison.

spec.title: 05 — Domibus · Network
